predecessors.name: Federated Republic of Mexico
predecessors.text: the three northern states, the land Cliopatria's Federated Republic of Mexico shape of 1840 gives up to this row

successors.name: Centralist Republic of Mexico
successors.text: the three states returned to the Centralist Mexican government after the surrender at Camargo on 6 November 1840

ledger.x: 1840: northern federalists proclaim the Republic of the Rio Grande near Laredo.
1840: the government retreats to Victoria, Texas.
1840: Canales surrenders at Camargo and the republic ends.
1840: the Republic of the Rio Grande dissolves; its claimed land is back under the Mexican government.

wars.name: Rio Grande rebellion
wars.outcome: The federalist rebellion of 17 January to 6 November 1840 failed: Canales fought the Mexican army at Santa Rita de Morelos, San Fernando (where he lost 250 of his 400 men), Mier, Monterrey's outskirts and Saltillo (25 October 1840) and surrendered at Camargo…

certainty.note: The republic's extent is a claim to three states, not a held frontier; the page names only river towns the rebels held.
